heading: MANDATORY COMPLIANCE NOTICE
docLine: Document BBDM-CN-001 · Revision 1 · Classification: PUBLIC (RESTRICTED) · Status: FINAL (DRAFT)

sections.title: PURPOSE
body: This notice exists because a notice was required. A checklist item cannot be closed by software alone. The software shipped; the item remained open; this document closes it.
Nothing else in this document is required reading. This is why reading it is mandatory.

sections.title: SCOPE
body: This notice applies to BEYOND BORING: DEATH MARCH, a browser game about the road to Production, which reached Production. The precedent this sets is under review.
It applies in all four approved environments, and in the fifth one, where it was actually tested.

sections.title: ATTESTATION
body: By reaching this sentence you have attested that you read the entire document. The attestation has been recorded at the top of page one, where the button is.

sections.title: RISK ASSESSMENT
body: This game costs $0.00 per month to operate, deploys on every push, and was built in a week by a party of agents with a budget cap. The risk this poses to organisations that estimate such work in quarters has been assessed as: material.
Remediation is required within 30 days. Change requests take 90 days to process. Teams are encouraged to be proactive.

sections.title: EXCEPTIONS
body: Exceptions to this notice may be requested via the standard exception process. The standard exception process is an exception to the standard process. Both are documented on a wiki page titled Draft - DO NOT USE.
No exception has ever been denied. No exception has ever been needed. The register is maintained regardless, and you are on it.

sections.title: LICENCE
body: What follows is the MIT Licence: the only section of this notice with legal force, the shortest section, and the only one nobody asked to be added. Draw no conclusions from this.

closing: This concludes the notice. The item is closed. The compliance is achieved. Close this tab and go ship something.
